stemMd: A cell of the pancreas makes a digestive enzyme, which is a protein, and secretes it into a duct. Which sequence lists, in order, the compartments through which the enzyme passes after it has been made on ribosomes, until it leaves the cell?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Rough endoplasmic reticulum, then Golgi apparatus, then secretory vesicle, then plasma membrane

options.label: B
options.textMd: Rough endoplasmic reticulum, then lysosome, then Golgi apparatus, then plasma membrane

options.label: C
options.textMd: Rough endoplasmic reticulum, then secretory vesicle, then mitochondrion, then plasma membrane

options.label: D
options.textMd: Nucleus, then Golgi apparatus, then secretory vesicle, then plasma membrane

options.label: E
options.textMd: Golgi apparatus, then rough endoplasmic reticulum, then secretory vesicle, then plasma membrane

explanationMd:
Follow the protein from where it is made. Ribosomes on the rough endoplasmic reticulum build the polypeptide directly into the reticulum, where it is folded. Transport vesicles carry it to the Golgi apparatus, which modifies and sorts it. Secretory vesicles then bud off the Golgi apparatus, move to the cell surface and fuse with the plasma membrane, releasing the enzyme by exocytosis.

So the order is rough ER, Golgi apparatus, secretory vesicle, plasma membrane. Wrong sequences either reverse the first two stages, add an organelle that has nothing to do with export (lysosome, mitochondrion), or start in the nucleus, which makes RNA rather than protein.

distractorRationale.b: Lysosomes are digestive compartments that receive enzymes for use inside the cell. A secreted enzyme goes from the Golgi apparatus to the cell surface instead.
distractorRationale.c: Mitochondria supply ATP and are not on the secretory route, and the Golgi apparatus, which processes and sorts the protein, is missing.
distractorRationale.e: This puts the steps in the wrong order. The protein enters the endoplasmic reticulum as it is made and only afterwards reaches the Golgi apparatus.
distractorRationale.d: The nucleus holds the gene and makes the mRNA, but the protein is made on ribosomes, so it never travels through the nucleus.

accessibilityText: A short text question with no figure. A pancreatic cell makes and secretes a digestive enzyme. Each of the five choices is a sequence of four cell compartments joined by the word then. One is rough endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, secretory vesicle, plasma membrane. The others reverse the order, or include a lysosome, a mitochondrion or the nucleus.

provenance.notes: Original item on the secretory pathway. Distractors are a reordering and three sequences that insert an organelle unrelated to export.

review.author: tolc-f-wave6-author

independentSolve.workingNotes: The standard secretory route is RER, then Golgi, then secretory vesicle, then exocytosis at the plasma membrane. The other options put a lysosome or mitochondrion in the pathway, start in the nucleus, or reverse the Golgi and RER order. [A second, separate blind solve (blind-reviewer-wave6-tolcf-bio-run19) reached the same answer: The secretory pathway runs rough ER, then Golgi, then secretory vesicle, then exocytosis at the plasma membrane. The other options put in a lysosome, a mitochondrion or the nucleus, or put the Golgi before the ER.]
